exposure: Caesarean delivery surgical techniques (e.g., uterine incision closure method, fascia extension method, uterine incision extension method, peritoneal closure method)
outcome: Frequency and prevalence of specific Caesarean delivery surgical techniques practiced by obstetricians
cohort: The study included 251 obstetricians and gynecologists practicing in Ethiopia who are members of the Ethiopian Society of Obstetrician and Gynecologists.
finding: There is a wide variation in the techniques of Caesarean Delivery practiced by Ethiopian Obstetricians and Gynecologists.
mod_finding: Significant variations exist in practices such as blunt versus sharp fascia extension, cephalo-caudad versus lateral uterine incision extension, and closure versus non-closure of pelvic and parietal peritoneum during Cesarean deliveries.
